title: Light-Ray Supersymmetry, BMS Algebras and the Averaged Null Energy Condition
summary: We show that the light-ray algebra of unitary supersymmetric Lorentzian conformal field theories contains a universal supersymmetric generalized $\mathfrak{bms}$ algebra. We construct parallel light-ray operators using the supersymmetry current, $R-$symmetry current and the stress tensor supported on a co-dimension one null hypersurface and determine their graded commutators in $d=3,4$ to verify this claim.
